```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| cache: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(bayesma)
library(posterior)
library(loo)
library(scoringRules)

# Reproducibility
set.seed(1404)
options(
  mc.cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  digits = 3
)

# Analysis constants (protocol Section 2.7, Table 1; Section 2.8.10)
MCID_LOS_DAYS   <- 0.5    # hospital length of stay
MCID_RES_HOURS  <- 6      # time to DKA resolution / insulin infusion duration
MCID_RES24_PROP <- 0.10   # proportion resolved at 24 h
ROPE_LOS        <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
ROPE_LOS_ALT    <- list(narrow = c(-0.25, 0.25), wide = c(-1, 1))
ROPE_ROM        <- c(0.93, 1.07)

# Load data
d_dir <- here::here("Data", "Clean")
m_dir <- here::here("Data", "Models")

read_d <- function(name) readRDS(file.path(d_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")))
read_m <- function(name) readRDS(file.path(m_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")))

# --- datasets ---
dat <- read_d("dat")
dat_hosp_los <- read_d("dat_hosp_los")          # MD (Wan) - primary
dat_icu_los <- read_d("dat_icu_los")            # MD (Wan)
dat_time_res <- read_d("dat_time_res")          # MD (Wan)
dat_insulin_dur <- read_d("dat_insulin_dur")    # MD (Wan)
dat_mortality <- read_d("dat_mortality")        # log-RR
dat_hosp_los_dom <- read_d("dat_hosp_los_dom")  # difference in medians
dat_rom <- read_d("dat_rom")                    # log ratio of medians
counts <- read_d("counts")

method_labels <- c(
  wan = "Wan",
  luo = "Luo",
  qe = "Quantile Estimation",
  bc = "Box-Cox",
  shi = "Shi",
  yang = "Yang")

#dat_icu_los <- dat_icu_los |> 
  #mutate(mean_int = mean_int/24,
    #mean_ctrl = mean_ctrl/24,
    #sd_int = sd_int/24,
    #sd_ctrl = sd_ctrl/24)

```

# Results

## Trials

```{r}
#| label: trial-counts

n_trials       <- counts$n_trials
n_participants <- counts$n_participants
n_primary      <- counts$n_primary
n_primary_pts  <- counts$n_primary_pts
```

The search identified `r n_trials` eligible trials with
`r n_participants` participants. Of these, `r n_primary` trials
(`r n_primary_pts` participants) reported hospital length of stay in a
form that could be pooled and contributed to the primary analysis.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-incl-trials
#| tbl-cap: "Characteristics of included trials."

tbl1data <- dat |> 
  dplyr::select(Author, year, country, trial_design, setting, age_group, n_centres, bss_type, ctrl_type, n_analysed_int, n_analysed_ctrl, fluid_vol_mean_int, fluid_vol_sd_int, fluid_vol_median_int, fluid_vol_iqr_int, fluid_vol_mean_ctrl, fluid_vol_sd_ctrl, fluid_vol_median_ctrl, fluid_vol_iqr_ctrl, age_mean_int, age_sd_int, age_median_int, age_iqr_int, age_mean_ctrl, age_sd_ctrl, age_median_ctrl, age_iqr_ctrl, n_male_int, n_male_ctrl, type1_int, type2_int, type_other_int, type1_ctrl, type2_ctrl, type_other_ctrl) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    trial_design = dplyr::recode_values(
      trial_design,
      "rct" ~ "Individual-patient RCT",
      "XRCT" ~ "Crossover RCT",
      "cRCT" ~ "Cluster RCT",
      "CXRCT" ~ "Cluster-crossover RCT"),
    bss_type = case_when(
      bss_type == "plasmalyte_a" ~ "Plasmalyte A",
      bss_type == "ringers" ~ "Ringer's Solution",
      bss_type == "ringerfundin" ~ "Ringerfundin",
      bss_type == "sterofundin" ~ "Sterofundin",
      bss_type == "plasmalyte_ringers" ~ "Plasmalyte or Ringer's",
      bss_type == "hartmanns" ~ "Hartmann's Solution"), 
    ctrl_type = "0.9% NaCl",
    study = str_glue("{Author} ({year})"),
    int_type_number = str_glue("{bss_type} ({n_analysed_int})"),
    ctrl__type_number = str_glue("{ctrl_type} ({n_analysed_ctrl})"),
    fluid_vol_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(fluid_vol_mean_int) & !is.na(fluid_vol_sd_int) ~
        paste0(round(fluid_vol_mean_int), " (", round(fluid_vol_sd_int), ")"),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_mean_int) ~ as.character(round(fluid_vol_mean_int)),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_median_int) & !is.na(fluid_vol_iqr_int) ~
        paste0(round(fluid_vol_median_int), " (", fluid_vol_iqr_int, ")"),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_median_int) ~ as.character(round(fluid_vol_median_int)),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    fluid_vol_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(fluid_vol_mean_ctrl) & !is.na(fluid_vol_sd_ctrl) ~
        paste0(round(fluid_vol_mean_ctrl), " (", round(fluid_vol_sd_ctrl), ")"),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_mean_ctrl) ~ as.character(round(fluid_vol_mean_ctrl)),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_median_ctrl) & !is.na(fluid_vol_iqr_ctrl) ~
        paste0(round(fluid_vol_median_ctrl), " (", fluid_vol_iqr_ctrl, ")"),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_median_ctrl) ~ as.character(round(fluid_vol_median_ctrl)),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    # Age: mean (SD) or median (IQR)
    age_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(age_mean_int) & !is.na(age_sd_int) ~
        paste0(round(age_mean_int, 1), " (", round(age_sd_int, 1), ")"),
      !is.na(age_mean_int) ~ as.character(round(age_mean_int, 1)),
      !is.na(age_median_int) & !is.na(age_iqr_int) ~
        paste0(round(age_median_int, 1), " (", age_iqr_int, ")"),
      !is.na(age_median_int) ~ as.character(round(age_median_int, 1)),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    age_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(age_mean_ctrl) & !is.na(age_sd_ctrl) ~
        paste0(round(age_mean_ctrl, 1), " (", round(age_sd_ctrl, 1), ")"),
      !is.na(age_mean_ctrl) ~ as.character(round(age_mean_ctrl, 1)),
      !is.na(age_median_ctrl) & !is.na(age_iqr_ctrl) ~
        paste0(round(age_median_ctrl, 1), " (", age_iqr_ctrl, ")"),
      !is.na(age_median_ctrl) ~ as.character(round(age_median_ctrl, 1)),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    # Sex: N (%)
    male_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(n_male_int) ~
        paste0(n_male_int, " (", round(100 * n_male_int / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    female_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(n_male_int) ~
        paste0(n_analysed_int - n_male_int, " (",
               round(100 * (n_analysed_int - n_male_int) / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    male_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(n_male_ctrl) ~
        paste0(n_male_ctrl, " (", round(100 * n_male_ctrl / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    female_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(n_male_ctrl) ~
        paste0(n_analysed_ctrl - n_male_ctrl, " (",
               round(100 * (n_analysed_ctrl - n_male_ctrl) / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    # Diabetes type: N (%)
    t1_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type1_int) ~
        paste0(type1_int, " (", round(100 * type1_int / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    t1_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type1_ctrl) ~
        paste0(type1_ctrl, " (", round(100 * type1_ctrl / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    t2_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type2_int) ~
        paste0(type2_int, " (", round(100 * type2_int / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    t2_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type2_ctrl) ~
        paste0(type2_ctrl, " (", round(100 * type2_ctrl / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    type_other_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type_other_int) ~
        paste0(type_other_int, " (", round(100 * type_other_int / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    type_other_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type_other_ctrl) ~
        paste0(type_other_ctrl, " (", round(100 * type_other_ctrl / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  )

# Convert to long format for grouping
tbl1_long <- bind_rows(
   tbl1data |>
     transmute(study, age_group, setting, trial_design,
               arm = int_type_number,
               age = age_int, male = male_int, female = female_int,
               fluid_vol = fluid_vol_int,
               t1dm = t1_int, t2dm = t2_int, other_dm = type_other_int),
   tbl1data |>
     transmute(study, age_group, setting, trial_design,
               arm = ctrl__type_number,
               age = age_ctrl, male = male_ctrl, female = female_ctrl,
               fluid_vol = fluid_vol_ctrl,
               t1dm = t1_ctrl, t2dm = t2_ctrl, other_dm = type_other_ctrl)) |>
   arrange(study) |>
   # Blank out study-level columns on the second (ctrl) row
   group_by(study) |>
   mutate(across(c(trial_design, setting, age_group),
                 ~ if_else(row_number() > 1, NA_character_, as.character(.)))) |>
   ungroup() |>
   # Collapse sex and diabetes type into single columns
   mutate(
     sex = pmap_chr(list(male, female), \(m, f) {
       parts <- c(
         if (!is.na(m)) paste0("Male: ", m),
         if (!is.na(f)) paste0("Female: ", f))
       if (length(parts) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(parts, collapse = "<br>")
     }),
     dm_type = pmap_chr(list(t1dm, t2dm, other_dm), \(t1, t2, ot) {
       parts <- c(
         if (!is.na(t1)) paste0("Type-1: ", t1),
         if (!is.na(t2)) paste0("Type-2: ", t2),
         if (!is.na(ot)) paste0("Other: ", ot))
       if (length(parts) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(parts, collapse = "<br>")
     })) |>
   select(-male, -female, -t1dm, -t2dm, -other_dm)

# Create table
tbl1 <- tbl1_long |>
   gt(groupname_col = "study") |>
   tab_stubhead(label = "Study") |>
   tab_header(title = "Table 1: Characteristics of Included Trials") |>
   opt_align_table_header(align = "left") |>
   cols_label(
     age_group = "Population",
     setting = "Setting",
     trial_design = "Trial Design",
     arm = "Intervention (n)",
     age = "Age",
     sex = "Sex, n (%)",
     dm_type = "Diabetes Type, n (%)",
     fluid_vol = "IV Fluid (mL)") |>
   cols_move(columns = fluid_vol, after = dm_type) |>
   sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
   fmt_markdown(columns = c(sex, dm_type)) |>
   tab_options(
     row_group.as_column = TRUE,
     row_group.border.top.width = px(3),
     row_group.font.weight = "bold",
     table.border.bottom.width = px(3),
     table.border.bottom.color = "black",
     table.border.top.color = "white",
     heading.border.bottom.color = "black",
     heading.border.bottom.width = px(3),
     heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
     table.font.size = px(12)) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_body(columns = everything(), rows = everything()),
     style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "white")) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_column_labels(columns = everything()),
     style = list(
       cell_text(weight = "bold"),
       cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(3)))) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything()),
     style = cell_text(weight = "bold")) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_stubhead(),
     style = list(
       cell_text(weight = "bold"),
       cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(3)))) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_body(columns = everything()),
     style = cell_borders(sides = "left", weight = px(1), color = "lightgrey")) |>
   cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) |>
   tab_footnote(
     footnote = "Age reported as mean (SD) or median (Q1, Q3). IV Fluid reported as mean (SD) or median (Q1, Q3).",
     locations = cells_column_labels(columns = age))

tbl1
```

## Primary Outcome

```{r}
#| label: primary-outcome-fit
#| include: false

fit_hosp_los_re <- bayesma(
  data       = dat_hosp_los,
  studyvar   = "Author",
  mean_ctrl = "mean_ctrl",
  mean_int  = "mean_int",
  sd_ctrl = "sd_ctrl",
  sd_int = "sd_int",
  n_ctrl     = "n_ctrl",
  n_int      = "n_int",
  likelihood = "gaussian",
  estimand   = "MD",
  model_type = "random_effect",
  stage      = "two_stage",
  mu_prior   = normal(0, 1),
  tau_prior  = half_normal(0, 0.75))

```

The pooled mean difference in hospital length of stay was
`r round(fit_hosp_los_re$summary$median[1], 2)` days (95% CrI
`r round(fit_hosp_los_re$summary$q2.5[1], 2)` to
`r round(fit_hosp_los_re$summary$q97.5[1], 2)`), with a posterior
probability of benefit (shorter stay with BMES) of
`r scales::percent(mean(fit_hosp_los_re$draws$mu < 0), accuracy = 0.1)`
and a posterior probability of a clinically meaningful reduction (\>
`r MCID_LOS_DAYS` days) of
`r scales::percent(mean(fit_hosp_los_re$draws$mu < -MCID_LOS_DAYS), accuracy = 0.1)`.

::: panel-tabset

```{r, warning=FALSE}

forest(model = fit_hosp_los_re,

       estimand = "MD",
       studyvar   = "Author",
       year = "year",
       c_mean = "mean_ctrl",
       i_mean  = "mean_int",
       c_sd = "sd_ctrl",
       i_sd = "sd_int",
```

```{r}
  data = dat_hosp_los,
  studyvar = "Author",
  mean_ctrl = "mean_ctrl",
  mean_int  = "mean_int",
  sd_ctrl = "sd_ctrl",
  sd_int = "sd_int",
  n_int = "n_int",
  n_ctrl = "n_ctrl",
  likelihood = "gaussian")

bayesma::egger_plot(egger_hosp_los, type = "beta_posterior")
```
:::

## Subgroup Analysis

Subgroup analyses were pre-specified for the primary outcome only
(protocol Table 2): age group (adults \$\geq\$18 years versus children
\<18 years) and BMES type. Subgroup-specific pooled estimates and the
posterior difference between subgroups are reported.

::: panel-tabset


### Summary Table

```{r,warning=FALSE}
summary_row <- function(fit, outcome, estimand, unit, ratio = FALSE, digits = 2) {
  mu <- fit$summary$median[1]
  est <- if (ratio) exp(mu) else mu
  low.cri <- fit$summary$q2.5[1]
  high.cri <- fit$summary$q97.5[1]

  tibble::tibble(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Estimand = estimand,
    `Estimate (95% CrI)` = sprintf(
      paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f to %.", digits, "f)%s"),
      est, low.cri, high.cri, if (nzchar(unit)) paste0(" ", unit) else ""),
    `Pr(Benefit)` = mean(fit$draws$mu < 0))
}

dplyr::bind_rows(
  summary_row(fit_hosp_los_re, "Hospital LOS", "MD", "days"),
  summary_row(fit_icu_los_re, "ICU LOS", "MD", "hours"),
  summary_row(fit_dka_res_re, "Time to DKA resolution", "MD", "hours"),
  summary_row(fit_insulin_dur_re, "Duration of insulin infusion", "MD", "hours"),
  summary_row(fit_mort_re, "Mortality", "RR", "", ratio = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Group = c("Primary", rep("Secondary", dplyr::n() - 1)), .before = 1) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Group") |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**BMES vs 0.9% NaCl: pooled effects**"),
    subtitle = "Bayesian random-effects meta-analysis") |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = dplyr::starts_with("Pr("), decimals = 2) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Posterior probability the effect favours BMES (shorter stay/duration, lower mortality).",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Pr(Benefit)`)) |>
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "\u2014")


```

## Assessment of Bias

Risk of bias was assessed with the Clarity tool adapted for cluster
designs. Small-study and publication bias were assessed with a
contour-enhanced funnel plot and Bayesian Egger regression, with the
posterior slope reported as a median and 95% credible interval. With a
low number of trials both have low power and are sensitive to the
assumed within-trial variances; they are reported descriptively and are
not used to adjust the pooled estimate.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Risk of bias assessment (DistillerSR tool, adapted for cluster designs)."
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-align: center

bayesfoRest::rob_plot(data = dat_rob, add_rob_legend = TRUE, rob_tool = "distillersr", show_overall = FALSE)
```

## Assessment of Heterogeneity

Between-trial heterogeneity is characterised by $\tau$ (posterior median
and 95% credible interval), with the prediction interval for a new trial
reported alongside the posterior for $\mu$. Because $\tau$ may be weakly
informed at this number of trials, we additionally assess whether the
heterogeneity estimate is data-informed rather than prior-driven, and
whether it is consistent with its prior (no prior–data conflict).

```{r}
#| label: heterogeneity-assessment

source("Functions.R")

pd <- prior_dominance(fit_hosp_los_re, data = dat_hosp_los, tau_grid = c(0.5, 0.75, 1.5))

tau_draws <- fit_hosp_los_re$draws$tau
tau_med <- stats::median(tau_draws)
tau_ci <- stats::quantile(tau_draws, c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)

tau_contraction <- pd$contraction$contraction[pd$contraction$parameter == "tau"]
tau_pctile <- pd$percentile$prior_percentile[pd$percentile$parameter == "tau"]
tau_flag <- pd$percentile$flag[pd$percentile$parameter == "tau"]
```

Between-trial heterogeneity was $\tau =$ `r round(tau_med, 2)` days (95%
CrI `r round(tau_ci[1], 2)` to `r round(tau_ci[2], 2)`). The
heterogeneity estimate had a posterior contraction of
`r round(tau_contraction, 2)`, and its posterior median lay at the
`r scales::percent(tau_pctile, accuracy = 1)` percentile of its prior
(`r tau_flag`).

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 9
#| out-width: "70%"
#| fig-align: center

overall_plot(fit_hosp_los_re, add_mu = FALSE, add_tau = TRUE, estimand = "MD")

```

## Sensitivity Analysis

The robustness of the primary estimate was assessed against (i)
alternative estimands — difference in medians, ratio of medians, and
mean difference using alternative median-to-mean conversion methods;
(ii) alternative model specifications; (iii) alternative priors for
$\mu$ — vague $N(0, 3)$ and informative $N(-0.5, 0.30)$ days, with
$\tau \sim \text{HN}(0, 0.75)$ unchanged; (iv) exclusion of trials at
high risk of bias (protocol 2.8.9); and (v) the specification of the
heterogeneity prior.

::: panel-tabset

```{r}
# Output table
mu_draws <- function(fit) fit$draws$mu

est_row <- function(fit, estimand, method, mcid, ratio = FALSE) {
  mu <- mu_draws(fit)

  q <- c(fit$summary$median[1], fit$summary$q2.5[1], fit$summary$q97.5[1])
  if (ratio) q <- exp(q)

  tibble::tibble(
    Estimand = estimand,
    Method = method,
    k = nrow(fit$data),
    `Estimate [95% CrI]` = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", q[1], q[2], q[3]),
    `Pr(Benefit)` = mean(mu < 0),
    `Pr(Benefit > MCID)` = mean(mu < mcid))
}

dplyr::bind_rows(
  fits_mean |>
    purrr::imap(\(fit, m) {
      est_row(
        fit,
        estimand = "Mean difference (days)",
        method   = paste0(method_labels[[m]], if (m == "wan") " (primary)" else ""),
        mcid     = -MCID_LOS_DAYS)
    }) |>
    purrr::list_rbind(),
  est_row(fit_diff_median, "Difference in medians (days)", "Quantile Estimation",
          mcid = -MCID_LOS_DAYS),
  est_row(fit_rom, "Ratio of medians", "Log-scale delta method",
          mcid = log(ROPE_ROM[1]), ratio = TRUE)) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Estimand") |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = dplyr::starts_with("Pr("), decimals = 2) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.border.top.width = gt::px(2),
    table.border.top.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.top.width = gt::px(2),
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.width = gt::px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table_body.border.bottom.width = gt::px(2),
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "black") |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      gt::cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = gt::px(2), color = "black")),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(columns = dplyr::everything())) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      gt::cell_fill(color = "grey90"),
      gt::cell_borders(sides = "top", weight = gt::px(2), color = "black"),
      gt::cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = gt::px(2.5), color = "black")),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups(groups = dplyr::everything())) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "MCID: 0.5 days for differences; ratio < 0.93 for the ratio of medians.",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Pr(Benefit > MCID)`)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Yan 2024 excluded for Quantile Estimation, Box-Cox and Shi due to implausible conversion of its bimodal control-arm distribution.",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(Method))
```

## Heterogeneity ($\tau$) Priors

The pooled effect was examined across a range of half-normal priors for
the between-trial heterogeneity $\tau$, holding the $\mu$ prior fixed.
For each prior we report the pooled mean difference, the heterogeneity
estimate, and whether the data conflict with that prior.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tau-sensitivity
#| tbl-cap: "Prior-dominance assessment: posterior contraction, prior percentile of the posterior median, and the pooled effect across a grid of tau priors."

gt_prior_dominance(pd)

sweep_tau <- tau_scale_sweep(
  fit_hosp_los_re,
  data = dat_hosp_los,
  scales = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 3))

plot_tau_scale_sweep(sweep_tau, null_value = 0)
```

Across half-normal priors for $\tau$ with scales from 0.5 to 1.5 days,
the pooled mean difference ranged from
`r sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", min(pd$tau_sensitivity$mu_median), max(pd$tau_sensitivity$mu_median))`
days (a shift of `r round(diff(range(pd$tau_sensitivity$mu_median)), 3)`
days).

## Model Diagnostics

Convergence was assessed by $\hat{R} < 1.01$, bulk and tail effective
sample sizes above 400 per chain, absence of divergent transitions, and
inspection of trace, rank and autocorrelation plots. Fit was assessed by
posterior predictive checks. Models failing these criteria are reported
as non-convergent rather than interpreted (protocol 2.8.10).
